The parent pilkwang seed314159 (9bac2fa0) is at experiments/exp02_pub941_holdout12/results/secondary_seed_weights/unet_transformer/split_0/edge_predictor_best.pth. The exp71 FT (ed8c616b) differs from it in exactly 10 keys, and the BN running stats are equal. theta0 + k*(theta_ft - theta0) was built on those 10 keys in float64, all finite, with every other key byte-equal to the FT. torch.save is deterministic. k=2 weight sha256 = 30f7eec37ac4c17495d4536eb1120ef857755ad612d86bd5e93cb41598c4ab01; k=3 = a852ed110ba84a717c0cfe4b5c2aa7639a69eaf04f4c245a3c2f740b629257a9. They are staged in x138's secondary layout as _dl/secft_x2_ds and _dl/secft_x3_ds (private CC0 ids vitaliineibauer/biohub-secft-x2-v1 and -x3-v1). Scratch builds with builder d46a8b2d reproduce exp76d byte for byte (ipynb 89d71960, meta 57c0f560). exp76x2_k2fm_secx2 (ipynb 24910592) and exp76x3_k2fm_secx3 (ipynb 9bb96570) differ from exp76d only in the two SECONDARY_* override lines and the dataset source. Governance: N1 is still I-384 deferred-after-deadline, and pre-score card (6) forbids an N1 build before the deadline. Submitting x2 therefore needs a NEW explicit user OK and a card amendment logged BEFORE the exp76d score. Honest value: P(x2 lifts our best public display) ~0.04-0.06, worth ~80 public places when it hits (0.955 -> 0.956); private value ~0 or negative. x3 is dominated: it loses a GT centre in-sample and needs a two-step monotone read. Nothing new reaches R8.

exp76d code per card (1), read at its first terminal header plus one LB download:
P5 (>= 0.955) -> submit x2 in the next free 28 Sep slot, >= 20 min from any other submit (masking), public-only. Target display >= 0.956.
U4 (0.954 and >= 1 TeamId passed that nothing else explains) -> submit x2 (the best chance to cross the 0.9545 edge if the effect is real and linear).
N4 (0.954, 0 passed) -> FT line closed (card (6)); no x2, no x3.

MASKED -> use exp72 only if exp72 was scored in a clean window (P5/U4 -> as above); otherwise hold, no x2.

x2 read -> x3 only if ALL hold: x2 P5 with display > exp76d's display (two-step monotone dose), x3 dummy clean, and a slot BEFORE the 29 Sep 02:00Z ladder cap (or the user lifted it).
